title: colander form schema
description: Base template for the form document colander compiles (docs/documents.md#form-schema). Uses only keywords from the subset colander itself implements (docs/json-schema.md, SPEC S-1..S-7), with local #/$defs references only, so this file also works when passed to colander_validate_schema.

schemaVersion.description: The form's own version. The rules document references it as formSchemaVersion; both present and different is RULE_SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH.

$schema.description: Copied to the compiled output only; otherwise inert.

fields.description: The field tree. Required by colander_compile, where a missing fields is an error; other entry points read an absent fields as empty.

field.description: One form field. Unknown keys are preserved verbatim by compile (SPEC P-7), so this stays open: only the read keys are listed.

id.description: Stable identifier; keys the rule maps and the UI fields map. Must be a present string (null counts as absent and is an error); may be empty for compile alone.

code.description: Answer key; keys values and calculatedValues. Duplicates are rejected only by the dependency check. Must be a present string; may be empty for compile alone.

type.description: Exactly these twelve names, matched case-sensitively with no aliases (SPEC D-2). Anything else fails response validation with UNSUPPORTED_FIELD_TYPE.

readOnly.description: Seeds enabled:false in the evaluation. A field carrying calculate must set this (RULE_CALCULATE_NOT_READONLY).

items.description: Children of a group, repeater or component-ref.

options.description: Read for choice fields: missing or empty options fail response validation with INVALID_SCHEMA. Other entry points tolerate them.

value.description: One accepted answer. Non-string values are silently skipped.

items.description: Each option carries a value; other keys, including label, are ignored.

allowMultiple.description: True makes a choice accept an array answer.

minLength.description: String constraint, counted in UTF-16 code units.

maxLength.description: String constraint, counted in UTF-16 code units.

pattern.description: Unanchored ECMA-262 pattern; an empty string is ignored, an uncompilable one is an error (SPEC S-6).

multipleOf.description: Numeric step; also derives decimal places for calculations.

minItems.description: Repeater row count minimum, enforced in Complete mode only.

maxItems.description: Repeater row count maximum, enforced in Complete mode only.

description.description: Copied through by compile; otherwise inert.

title.description: Copied through by compile; has no meaning on a form field.

componentCode.description: Required for component-ref: the published component to expand, resolved by exact (code, version) against the caller's batch.

componentVersion.description: Required for component-ref. Exactly three non-negative integers, no leading zeros, no pre-release or build metadata (SPEC P-5); absent or blank is COMPONENT_VERSION_REQUIRED.
